What changes occur with hormone therapy? Introduction to basic knowledge of treatment methods

Hormone therapy, as the name suggests, is a treatment method that uses hormones, and in the case of MtF,You will be inoculated with female hormones.

By inoculating with female hormones, female characteristics begin to appear in the body and mental changes begin to appear.

Here, we will introduce basic knowledge such as the changes in mind and body that occur with hormone therapy and the risks.

In addition to taking female hormones, there is also a method of removing the testicles to reduce the secretion of male hormones.

About changes in mind and body that occur with hormone therapy

Hormone treatment through female hormone inoculation will bring about feminine changes in both mind and body.

Specifically, the following changes will occur.

Physical changes and onset timing
  • Changes in the amount of body hair on arms, beard, etc.: 1 to 4 months
  • Decline in male function: 1 to 4 months
  • Increase in fat mass: 3-6 months
  • Muscle mass loss: 3-6 months
  • Breast swelling: 3-6 months
spiritual change
  • Decrease in masculine sexual desire: 1-4 months
  • Decrease in masculine aggression: 1-4 months

There are individual differences in the time of onset, and the time of onset may vary, butGenerally, changes begin to appear gradually in about 3 to 6 months.

About side effects of hormone therapy

Hormone therapy has a significant impact on the body, so the following side effects may occur:

  • deep vein thrombosis
  • stroke
  • myocardial infarction
  • breast cancer
  • liver dysfunction

The cause of this is thought to be related to the female hormone estrogen.

This is because estrogen has the effect of promoting blood coagulation, which makes it easier for blood to clot and cause blood clots, which can lead to the side effects mentioned above.

Female hormone medicine can be purchased online via overseas, but for the reasons mentioned above,Hormone treatment without a doctor's guidance is risky.

Therefore, it can be said that the safest and most reliable treatment method is to follow the doctor's instructions and avoid the risks as much as possible.

There are three types of hormone treatment for MtF: injection, oral intake, and transdermal intake.

Hormone treatment for MtF uses hormones, and there are three methods to choose from: injections, oral medication, and transdermal medication.

The characteristics of each are summarized below.

Here, we will explain the characteristics of injection, oral, and transdermal hormone therapy.

Hormone injection with immediate effect

Hormone injection is a treatment method that involves injecting male and female hormones.

Hormone injections are administered intramuscularly, somore immediate effectIt is said that

  • Advantages: Hormones are injected directly into the bloodstream, so it has an immediate effect and can be expected to be effective.
  • Disadvantages: Easily excreted in the urine and must be injected continuously.

Injections are usually given once every 2 to 4 weeks.

It is characterized by the fact that the blood concentration tends to be stable, so physical changes appear relatively quickly.

However, depending on the frequency and amount of injections, side effects and rapid fluctuations in hormones may cause your physical condition to become unstable, so appropriate management is required.

Oral intake with less psychological burden

Oral ingestion is a hormone treatment that involves taking and ingesting hormone drugs, and oral ingestion is the most common method of ingesting female hormones.

  • Advantages: Easy to take, less psychological burden
  • Disadvantages: Increased burden on the liver, increasing risk of side effects

This is a method of taking hormones in the form of tablets or capsules. Because it is easy to do, many peopleCharacterized by less psychological burdenIt is.

However, it may take some time to take effect and is absorbed through the digestive system.Increased burden on the liverThis is a concern.

It is important to follow your doctor's instructions regarding dosage and frequency.

Transdermal inoculation, which is easy to administer locally and maintain blood concentration

Transdermal administration is a hormone treatment that uses ointments or poultices, and is a treatment method in which hormones are applied to the skin and inoculated.

  • Advantages: Can be administered locally. It is highly safe as it can be administered in small doses, and it is easy to maintain a constant blood concentration.
  • Disadvantages: Can only be administered locally. Weak effect. Requires daily application

Dermal ingestion has a lower risk of side effects than injections or oral ingestion.Relatively safe for long-term useIt is said that

However, it requires daily use and requires ongoing management.

Frequently asked questions and answers about hormone therapy in MtF

There are still many unknowns about hormone therapy for MtF, and many people have doubts and concerns about the treatment period and effectiveness when actually performing it.

Here, we introduce frequently asked questions regarding hormone therapy in a Q&A format.

When do the effects of female hormones begin to appear?

Although there are individual differences,The effects tend to be felt within 1 to 4 months, and irreversible changes tend to occur after about 6 months.

This is because while the concentration of female hormones remains constant, male hormones decrease relatively, and as a result, masculine functions begin to weaken.

Depending on the person, it may take more than a year for complete visible changes to occur, so it is necessary to continue hormone treatment patiently.

To obtain long-term effects, continue regular treatment under the guidance of your doctor.

How often should I take hormone therapy?

Generally, this will be done once every 2 to 3 weeks.

Female hormones administered during hormone therapy are eliminated through metabolism.
In the case of MtF, where female hormones such as estrogen and progesterone cannot be secreted, hormone therapy must be performed periodically and female hormones must be administered.

What happens if you stop taking hormone injections?

If you suddenly stop taking estrogen after continuously receiving it,Physical and psychological changes caused by treatment may be gradually reversed.

In addition, hormonal balance may be disrupted, which can have various effects on the body, including milk secretion.

There is no residual effect from the drug, so the risk of life-threatening consequences is low, but health problems are likely to occur, so consult your doctor before quitting.

Summary

In this article, we have introduced the basic knowledge and treatment methods of hormone therapy in MTF.

Hormone therapy is a long-term treatment, and once treated, the condition is irreversible.

Therefore, you need to consult with your family, think about your future, and consider whether it is the right decision.

In this case, counseling at a clinic is effective, and it can be said that there are sufficient benefits to refer to the opinions of experts.
